_notes: Temporary recipient overrides for the board paper machine. Each rule ADDS extra recipient(s) to any alert that already goes to a named recipient, until an expiry date (inclusive). Applied in scan-boards Step 2, on top of each org's base recipient set (primary correspondent + additional_correspondents). Names must match keys in data/correspondents.json (same TBC/no-email handling). A rule is LIVE only when today is on or after `start` and on or before `expires`; once today is past `expires` the rule is ignored (left here for audit — safe to delete after expiry). `applies_to` limits which alert kinds the added name receives: "date" = date alerts, "papers" = papers alerts (incl. the DATE-UNKNOWN watchlist alert).

overrides.reason: Henry asked (2026-07-28) to copy Ella on all bpm emails that would normally go to Matt Discombe, for three months.
